name: Exponential Growth Explainer
summary: A calm math-channel graph: a curve doubles at equal time steps while the y axis keeps rescaling to hold it.
bestFor: Explaining compounding, growth and scale intuition
prompt: Explain exponential growth with a single curve. Draw the axes, then let the quantity double at every equal tick of time and mark each doubling with a dot. Show how the vertical axis has to rescale again and again just to keep the curve in view. Contrast it with steady addition, and finish on the idea that a constant doubling time means the curve eventually outruns any straight line.
